title: 🚨 Bihar:Cases Withdrawn! 🚨
description: Bihar sarkar ne yuva virodh se jude mamlo ko wapas lena ka faisla kiya hai, aur sabhi giraphtaron ko riha karne ka irada kiya hai. Yeh faisla Chief Justice of India aur vipakshi dalon dwara naye andolan ki dhamki ke baad aaya hai. Hum aapko apne channel AI-NewsTube ko subscribe karne aur is video ko like karne ki appeal karte hain, taaki aapko aisi hi mahatvapurna khabrein milte rahen. #BiharNews #YouthProtest #NEETVirodh #BiharGovernment #IndiaNews
